name: skreed-pre-launch
description: skreed.in pre-launch teaser: Astro 7 static on Cloudflare Workers + Static Assets
//build-modes: PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL=A|B|C picks section 4's travel between the lands, default A (PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL=C npm run build): A the pictures in depth, B the modelled park, C the clips (docs/specs/section-4-world.md 5, Build modes). build, build:test and build:staging each export it first, so astro build and every command after it read the same pick. build and build:test ship the pick only (astro.config.mjs resolves the other two to travel-stub.ts); build:staging (Tune on) carries all three. csp.mjs writes media-src 'self' on staging (--media self) and for a C build, 'none' otherwise. build and build:staging then run budget.mjs (section 6's lines and AC8's formats) and the post-build guard (no .mp4 unless C, no park asset unless B). This note sits outside scripts so that npm run cannot run it.

scripts.dev: PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=1 PUBLIC_TUNE=1 PUBLIC_STAGING=0 PUBLIC_FAMILY_3D=on astro dev
scripts.build: export PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL=${PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL:-A} && PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=0 PUBLIC_TUNE=0 PUBLIC_STAGING=0 astro build && node scripts/csp.mjs && node scripts/hero/budget.mjs dist --mode build && node scripts/room/guards.mjs --post-build --mode build
scripts.build:test: export PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL=${PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL:-A} && PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=1 PUBLIC_TUNE=0 PUBLIC_STAGING=0 astro build && node scripts/csp.mjs
scripts.build:staging: export PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL=${PUBLIC_PARK_TRAVEL:-A} && PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=1 PUBLIC_TUNE=1 PUBLIC_STAGING=1 astro build && node scripts/csp.mjs --media self && node scripts/hero/budget.mjs dist --mode staging && node scripts/room/guards.mjs --post-build --mode staging
